changeKinds.esm: Only module syntax changed: require() became import, module.exports became export. All other lines are as upstream.
changeKinds.modified: ESM conversion plus other changes. Each other change has a `// vendor:` comment.
changeKinds.generated: Generated by upstream from a grammar. Copy it from the npm tarball, then do the ESM conversion.
changeKinds.local: Not an upstream file. It replaces a Node-only module, or is new.

index.js.notes: Exports only parseFiles. Upstream also exports parse, generate, cache and others.

index.d.ts.notes: Types for index.js. Upstream ships no types.

cache/index.js.notes: No-op stub. Upstream uses fs and crypto for a disk cache.

maybe-yaml-parse/index.js.notes: Parses with the yaml package (a dependency of this package), with merge keys on, loaded with a dynamic import so that it stays optional. Upstream requires js-yaml lazily as an optional peer.

parse/parser.generated.js.notes: Upstream builds it from lib/parse/lookml.peg with scripts/build-parser.js (PEG.js 0.10, CommonJS). Only the final module.exports changed.

parse-files/file-loader.js.notes: Keeps only the in-memory input branch. Upstream also globs the file system and reads git (fs, glob, child_process).

parse-files/index.js.notes: bluebird and path come from shims/. performance comes from globalThis, not node:perf_hooks. The cache is the stub. The inner require of transform-ast moved to the top import.

shims/bluebird.js.notes: Promise.map for parse-files. Replaces the bluebird package.

shims/path.js.notes: Posix basename and dirname. Replaces the node path module.
